headline: Chips rebound ahead of AMD earnings and lift the Nasdaq about 1%, while Apple and Palantir fall after their reports on Election Day.
drivers: Stocks are mixed on Election Day, with the Nasdaq up about 1% as chip stocks bounce after a three-day sell-off and ahead of AMD's results tonight, even though Kospi and Taiwan fell about 3.6% overnight. The Dow is lower as Apple slides on a soft holiday-quarter gross-margin outlook, and Palantir is down despite a beat-and-raise as US bookings slowed. September JOLTS openings jumped to 7.52 million versus 7.10 million expected, keeping yields near 4.94% with Fed rate-hike talk from last week still in the background. Oil whipsawed on mixed US–Iran headlines (a reported US strike on Qeshm Island vs. talk of talks) and WTI is slightly lower after Monday's 7% drop; midterm results arrive tonight.
